responsibility: This is the main TI C6X target backend implementation file, owning the port’s target hooks and most machine-dependent logic across code generation, ABI handling, scheduling, and assembly emission. It interprets target options and ISA selection, validates and expands addresses and calls, implements calling convention and prologue/epilogue logic, handles section selection and unwind/EH output, defines builtins and intrinsic expansion, computes costs and mode support, and provides the custom exposed-pipeline and modulo-scheduling hooks that cooperate with attributes and patterns from the C6X machine descriptions.
same_name_distinction: Implements the C6X port’s executable backend behavior in C++, wiring the target hooks (`targetm`) and performing option-dependent code generation, ABI, scheduling, assembly, EH, and builtin handling. Unlike `c6x.h` it is not the macro/specification layer, unlike `c6x.md` it does not declaratively define RTL instruction patterns and attributes, and unlike `c6x.opt` it does not declare the command-line options themselves but consumes their parsed results.
